question:
Find the area of the given quadrilateral ABCD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a42dea6ad0f89fe6fdadff9c2a118ffbc99973fa0a0b161c3e2d78602b9f7c2.png]
solution:
**Formula used:**

Area of Triangle = (1)/(2) × Base × Height

**Calculations:**

According to the Question,

Area of quadrilateral ABCD,

⇒ Area of ∆ABC + Area of ∆ ADC

⇒ (1)/(2)× AC × BF + (1)/(2)× AC × DE

⇒ (1)/(2)× AC ( BF + DE )

⇒ (1)/(2) × 10 ( 5 + 3 )

⇒ 40 cm²

**∴The area of quadrilateral ABCD is 40 cm².**
